name: iact_hyades_ctao_alpha
label: The four Hyades giants on the CTAO-North alpha array (4 LSTs + 9 MSTs) at Stage I and II with NewEra PHOENIX stand-ins: the sidelobes to 560 m and the compact-versus-extended profile test
notes: Companion to iact_hyades_magic_lst1: the 68-560 m alpha baselines sample the second to the twelfth lobe of a 2.3-2.7 mas disk at 425 nm; the MST pairs' lower S/N per pair is repaid by 78 baselines.
